description: This file defines the internal class 'MembershipTableManager' which manages cluster membership information, handles synchronization with the membership table store, handles silo status updates, gossiping, and failure detection within the Orleans runtime. It implements lifecycle and health check interfaces, and coordinates membership state updates and suspect/kill logic.

classes.name: MembershipTableManager
classes.description: Manages the cluster membership table, performs periodic updates and cleanup, handles status changes, gossip, suspect/kill requests, and interacts with the membership table data store.

classes.name: MembershipTableManager.SuspectOrKillRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to suspect or kill a silo, used internally for processing suspect/kill logic asynchronously.

classes.name: MembershipTableManager.WithoutDuplicateDeadsLogValue
classes.description: A struct for logging purposes that wraps the membership table data with dead silos removed.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the membership table manager with dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes membership table, performs initial refresh and cleanup, and detects node migrations.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the local silo's IAmAlive timestamp in the membership table.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the silo's status (Active, Dead, Suspecting, etc.) in the membership table, with optional gossip.

methods.name: TryUpdateMyStatusGlobalOnce
methods.description: Attempts to update this silo's status in the membership table, returning success as a boolean.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Queues a request to kill a particular silo.

methods.name: ProcessSuspectOrKillLists
methods.description: Background task processing suspect or kill requests from the channel.

methods.name: InnerTryKill
methods.description: Attempts to mark a silo as dead in the membership table.

methods.name: InnerTryToSuspectOrKill
methods.description: Attempts to vote or mark a silo as suspected or dead.

methods.name: DeclareDead
methods.description: Marks a silo as dead in the membership table and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: GossipToOthers
methods.description: Gossips silo status updates to other silos, if gossiping is enabled.
